'''Phean Tic'Karcta''' was a disgruntled (and possibly jealous) tradeswoman from Arkonne III who sabotaged an official vehicle carrying [[Divina Quri Adner]], a woman to whom [[Wilek Nereus]] had proposed marriage. In response to the sabotage Nereus killed her and removed her teeth.
